lines.text: They had already suffered shameful treatment in Corinth, yet boldly spoke the gospel of God to the Thessalonians.
The apostles spoke to please God, who examines hearts, and never used flattery or sought praise from anyone.
They were gentle like a nursing mother and shared both the gospel and their own lives.
They worked night and day to burden no one, and treated each believer as a king treats his children.
The Thessalonians accepted the message as God's word and suffered from their own countrymen, as the churches in Judea had.
